name: Material Availability Board
summary: Read-only ShipRec analysis tool that lets users search by warehouse location or part number, review per-part stock cards, current positive-quantity locations, roll up incoming material using an ordered PO-line and PO-header date fallback chain, surface associated work orders by scheduled start date with explicit Past Job, Currently Running, and Future Run timing states, keep associated parts visible even when no scheduled run date is available, normalize work-order display values, open incoming-material and work-order detail dialogs, and print either a color-coded full summary with location totals and manual transfer rows or a handwritten transaction sheet as HTML.

userActions: Resolve fuzzy matches for locations or parts
Expand a card to review detailed stock and inbound material
Review rolled-up incoming material for the selected look-ahead window
Review which associated parent parts are scheduled to start next, are currently running, already ran, or have no current scheduled job
Open incoming-material details and print them
Open work-order details, reveal logic-only fields, and print them
Open a print-ready HTML version of the current results
Choose between a full summary printout and a transaction sheet when printing location-based results
preserveRules: Keep all Infor Visual access read-only
Keep warehouse scope explicit for location validation and stock queries
Keep cards collapsed by default after every new search
Keep part-level aggregation logic in the ShipRec tool service rather than in code-behind
Keep work-order field visibility and print selection driven by settings definitions rather than hardcoded UI switches
acceptanceCriteria: Location searches create one card per unique part in the selected location
Part-number searches still return a card when the part has no current positive-quantity locations
Each card shows all positive-quantity locations for the part within the current warehouse scope
Incoming material uses this date priority: line promise delivery, line promise ship, PO promise delivery, PO promise ship, desired receive date, then PO order date
Open PO lines remain visible in Incoming Material even when only lower-priority fallback dates are available
Associated part rows remain visible even when no scheduled run date is available for the selected look-ahead window
Associated part rows use scheduled start dates for the visible run date instead of finish-style demand dates
Associated part timing text explicitly states Past Job, Currently Running, or Future Run when a scheduled window exists
The collapsed card surfaces work order, parent part, date, required parts quantity, and estimated coil use without forcing expansion
Incoming material details open in a dedicated modal and print from a detail-specific HTML layout
Work-order details open in a categorized modal and print from a settings-driven field list
Cards start collapsed on initial load and after each search
Print opens a browser-hosted HTML document that mirrors the reporting-style section and table layout for the current board results
Full summary print removes the old per-card summary table and adds a Total on Hand footer plus a five-row manual transfer grid under Current Locations
Full summary print omits the Incoming Material section entirely when no incoming supply exists for a card
Full summary print applies consistent per-part color classes across each card's rows and sections
Location-based print flow offers a second transaction-sheet layout with repeatable page headers and per-coil destination fields
Work-order displays are normalized to a single WO- prefix in the UI and print output
validationHints: Confirm location and part search modes each resolve fuzzy matches before loading results
Confirm cards are sorted by the earliest associated part run date before cards with no run data
Confirm quantity display is rounded for UI only while aggregation still uses decimal values
Confirm incoming material still appears when active PO lines only have lower-priority fallback dates available
Confirm the incoming summary date follows this order: line promise delivery, line promise ship, PO promise delivery, PO promise ship, desired receive, order date
Confirm open PO lines stay visible instead of falling back to a historical shipment date for regular non-blanket POs

Confirm changing the look-ahead selector between 30, 60, 90, and All updates both incoming material and associated part results while still keeping associated parts visible when no scheduled run date qualifies
Confirm associated work-order Run date values come from scheduled start dates rather than finish-style requirement dates
Confirm jobs whose scheduled start is in the past but scheduled finish is still open render as Currently Running
Confirm completed or fully elapsed scheduled jobs render as Past Job and future scheduled jobs render as Future Run
Confirm whole-collection card replacement resets expansion state after a new search
Confirm search results only surface the page-level InfoBar status and no duplicate header notification
Confirm estimated coil use warns when the requirement-based estimate exceeds current on-hand quantity
Confirm the work-order modal Show all chip reveals the logic-only fields unless disabled in settings
Confirm Print is only useful after results are loaded and the generated document includes the current search term, warehouse scope, look-ahead window, and card details
Confirm the full summary print includes a Current Locations total row when location rows exist and a five-row Manual Inventory Transfers table for each card
Confirm cards with no positive-quantity Current Locations still show the Manual Inventory Transfers grid beneath the empty-state message
Confirm cards with no incoming supply omit the Incoming Material heading and tables entirely in the full summary print
Confirm associated-part Run date values in the full summary print prefer scheduled start, then next due-to-run, then No scheduled date
Confirm the full summary print CSS exposes the p-0 through p-14 palette and uses print color adjustment so part colors render on paper
Confirm location-based printing offers Full Summary and Transaction Sheet choices
Confirm the transaction sheet uses repeated table headers and enough blank handwriting space for multiple coil moves
Confirm work-order values with duplicate WO- prefixes are normalized before display and any downstream matching
